notes.title: Playtest Version 0.1.9
notes.notes:
[0.1.9] - 2025-06-28
Changed

 - Increased dialogue text speed
 - Made it harder to skip dialogue lines by mistake by mashing the skip button


Fixed

 - Fixed Audio settings not affecting certain sounds
 - Fixed crash caused by a memory leak in the enemy death dissolve effect
 - Fixed crash caused by enemies dying while affected by the static electricity status effect
 - Fixed crash caused by uncleaned enemy delegates
 - Fixed crash related to Figment enemy dissolve effect
 - Fixed crash caused by multihit attacks killing enemies mid-animation
 - Fixed memory leak in the Form Change mechanic that could cause crashes
 - Fixed crash when ending an encounter in the middle of a combo
 - Fixed crash caused by enemy health bar logic under edge conditions
 - Fixed crash when enemies despawn and later return while the player is far away
 - Fixed bug where enemies could remain invisible after dramatic zoom effects
 - Fixed a minor issue in the Boss Arena layout

notes.title: Playtest Version 0.1.8
notes.notes:
The main feature in this patch is crash reporting
You will now be able to send me crash reports directly from the game. No more looking for crash files. I will get your reports and have the info I need to keep improving the game's stability.

[0.1.8] - 2025-06-26

Added

- Added **Sentry crash reporting** integration for shipping builds
 - Enabled crash reporter for packaged versions
 - Updated **Main Menu**:
   - New Discord link
   - Updated YouTube link


Changed
- Environment level for **Forest Lakeside** was split for better modularity

Fixed

 - Fixed out-of-bounds issue in **Forest Lakeside**
 - Fixed combat skip bug in **Forest Path**
 - Fixed crash caused by passive abilities (HP/Mana upgrades) requesting gameplay tags too early
 - Ensured gameplay tags are verified during object construction
- Fixed **Thunder Cannon** camera issues when no enemy is available to lock onto
- Fixed **Thunder Laser** orientation to match new character skeleton
 - Fixed main menu music not stopping when starting the game
 - Added missing binary to source control to fix level name change bug
